set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: source-interface
parameters.explanation: Name of tunnel source interface, e.g. lo0.0.

tunnel mode [parameter3].explanation: The command `tunnel mode [parameter3]` in Junos sets the encapsulation mode for a tunnel interface, where `[parameter3]` specifies the type (e.g., GRE, IPIP).

set routing-options rib [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment creates or modifies a custom Routing Information Base (RIB) named `[parameter1]` within the routing options, allowing for separate routing tables.

static route [parameter2].explanation: This command adds a static route `[parameter2]` to the specified Routing Information Base (RIB) `[parameter1]` in Junos routing configuration.

parameters.name: route
parameters.explanation: Target IPv6 network address and prefix length.
